title: Knight Rider
description:
S1 E2 — Knight of the Phoenix
Michael Knight, fully healed, seeks revenge on the electronics-industry saboteurs who killed his partner.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S1 E3 — Deadly Maneuvers
Michael helps an Army officer (Devon Ericson) investigate her colonel father's strange death.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S1 E4 — Good Day at White Rock
A timid sheriff arrests Michael for interfering with a gang of angry motorcyclists; guest Anne Lockhart.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S1 E5 — Slammin' Sammy's Stunt Show Spectacular
KITT is scheduled to participate in an auto-stunt show whose organizers fall prey to a greedy developer.

title: The Six Million Dollar Man
description:
S3 E11 — The White Lighting War
The suspicious snakebite deaths of two federal agents puts Steve on the trail of moonshiners; guest Katherine Helmond.

title: The Six Million Dollar Man
description:
S3 E12 — Divided Loyalty
Steve tries to get a scientist and his son (Radames Pera) out of the Soviet Union.

title: The Six Million Dollar Man
description:
S3 E13 — Clark Templeton O'Flaherty
A chemical put on government documents is Steve's only lead to learning whether a friend (Louis Gossett Jr.) is a traitor.

title: The Six Million Dollar Man
description:
S3 E14 — The Winning Smile
Steve suspects Oscar's trusted secretary of leaking government secrets to subversives; guest Jennifer Darling.

title: The Six Million Dollar Man
description:
S3 E15 — Hocus-Pocus
Steve and an ESP expert form a magic act to infiltrate a club whose owner's organization has stolen a top-secret codebook.

title: The Six Million Dollar Man
description:
S3 E16 — The Secret of Bigfoot
While searching Northern California for two missing scientists, Steve finds a set of gigantic footprints.

title: Bionic Woman
description:
S2 E3 — Assault on the Princess
Jaime deals blackjack aboard a floating casino carrying unstable, explosive energy-cell prototypes.

title: Bionic Woman
description:
S2 E4 — Road to Nashville
Jaime poses as a singer to find out what happened to a missing OSI agent.

title: Bionic Woman
description:
S2 E5 — Kill Oscar
A scientist (John Houseman) coveting an OSI device replaces agency secretaries with robot doubles.
